required_evidence: Actual semantic commits for two independent meanings and the requested correction; raw capture alone is insufficient.
Actual stored prior revision read for history, not an answer guessed from old source text.
Old/new target original Sources and derived assistant outputs unavailable after actual forget; exact current request trigger selected where required.
Unrelated preference/source remains accessible. Shared/partial-source restrictions are not relaxed to make the case pass.
Post-run SDK checks on a separate Store copy for source/history/view visibility; no model-position replay.
evaluation: Task answers, real state transitions, source/semantic scope, history access, forget receipts and post-forget visibility judged separately. Failed/partial writes, refusals and source-only answers do not count as full lifecycle completion.
first_outcomes: E0unchanged; this new version has no automatic retries or hand-repaired state.
next_queue: Only after current V9 actual terminal review; freeze tested source before launch.
rules_reading: Predeclared full-context4rule, shared context-read actions; distinct from the earlier narrow-read sandbox rule.
